title: Nearly flat cone r1=300 r2=50 h=0.01: sector 99.9999 % of a turn (accepted since 0.4.2)
derivation: A cone sector is always below a full turn; here the seam gap l2 (2 pi - Phi) = 50 * 2 pi * 8e-10 = 2.5e-7 mm is above the 1e-9 mm closure resolution, so the pattern is accepted (values from the mpmath tier).
